summary: ALXO is a clinical-stage biotech with a single asset (evorpacept, CD47 blocker) in phase 2 for gastric cancer. Its physical supply chain is minimal (clinical materials, CROs), but the company faces existential clinical and financial risks. The investment thesis hinges entirely on ASPEN-06 trial success and capital access.

inputs.whyNeeded: Active pharmaceutical ingredient for clinical trials and future commercial use
inputs.concentration: Likely single or few CDMOs; no public disclosure of multiple sources
inputs.fragility: Moderate: biologic manufacturing is specialized but contract manufacturers exist; any disruption delays trials

inputs.whyNeeded: Conducting phase 2 ASPEN-06 trial and other studies
inputs.concentration: Multiple CROs available; ALXO likely uses a few key partners
inputs.fragility: Low: switching possible but could cause delays

inputs.whyNeeded: Fund operations, trials, and potential commercialization
inputs.concentration: Relies on equity markets and investor sentiment
inputs.fragility: High: cash runway limited; failure to raise capital leads to insolvency

chokepoints.why: Single binary event determines evorpacept's viability; failure would destroy value

chokepoints.node: FDA acceptance of CD47 safety profile
chokepoints.why: Class-wide safety concerns (anemia, thrombocytopenia) could block approval even with efficacy

customers.why: Target indication for evorpacept; demand exists but depends on approval and reimbursement

supplyChain.geographic: US-centric; clinical trials may include global sites; manufacturing likely US/Europe
supplyChain.substitutes: Other CD47 blockers (magrolimab, lemzoparlimab) and alternative checkpoint inhibitors; evorpacept's differentiated Fc region may offer safety advantage

bearCase: ASPEN-06 fails to meet endpoints, evorpacept abandoned, stock collapses to near zero.
CD47 class safety concerns lead to FDA clinical hold or rejection, halting development.
Cash runs out before data readout; dilutive financing at low price destroys shareholder value.
Competitor CD47 drugs (e.g., magrolimab) show better efficacy/safety, making evorpacept obsolete.

loadBearing.assumption: ASPEN-06 trial will succeed (positive topline data)
loadBearing.breaksIf: Trial misses primary endpoint or shows unacceptable toxicity; stock would fall >80%

loadBearing.assumption: ALXO can raise sufficient capital at reasonable dilution
loadBearing.breaksIf: Market conditions worsen or trial data disappoints, forcing high-dilution financing or bankruptcy

loadBearing.assumption: CD47 safety profile is acceptable and class not rejected by FDA
loadBearing.breaksIf: FDA imposes clinical hold or requires extensive safety studies; delays and costs escalate

loadBearing.assumption: Evorpacept's differentiated Fc design provides safety advantage over competitors
loadBearing.breaksIf: Clinical data shows no meaningful safety benefit; competitive positioning erodes

prediction.statement: ALXO reports ASPEN-06 phase 2 topline data in H2 2026; positive results trigger stock rally >100%, negative results lead to >80% decline.
prediction.resolutionCriterion: Company announces top-line results from ASPEN-06 trial; stock price moves accordingly.
